nail_salon.name: Grand / Petit — Nail Salon
nail_salon.description: A 4.3 metre surreal hand and a petite 32 cm copy share nail and skin colours selected by the existing RGB controllers. A fine manicure table, polish bottles and velvet stools place the contrast at body scale.
interactions: Use nearby nail_color_controller and hand_color_controller to recolour both display hands
nail_salon.qfep_connection: One mesh and two material addresses support two scales of bodily appearance; the same colour becomes monumental and intimate.
